# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module), env templates, and .tpl files
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Alloy Auth Middleware (for Loki/Prometheus push endpoints)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates authenticated endpoints for Alloy agents to push logs and metrics

resource "local_sensitive_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml.tpl", {
    htpasswd      = local.op.alloy_telemetry_htpasswd
    domain        = var.domain_internal
    monitoring_ip = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/alloy-auth.yml"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.alloy_auth_config.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# Common Traefik middlewares and transports for homelab
http:
  # ServersTransport for backends with self-signed certificates
  serversTransports:
    insecure:
      insecureSkipVerify: true

  middlewares:
    security-headers:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        forceSTSHeader: true
        stsIncludeSubdomains: true
        stsPreload: true
        stsSeconds: 31536000
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    public-security:
      headers:
        browserXssFilter: true
        contentTypeNosniff: true
        customFrameOptionsValue: "SAMEORIGIN"
        referrerPolicy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

    # Internal-only: Allow only local network, container network, and Tailscale
    internal-only:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "192.168.1.0/24"    # Local LAN
          - "10.100.0.0/16"     # Container network (LXC containers)
          - "172.16.0.0/12"     # Docker bridge networks (172.16-31.x.x)
          - "100.64.0.0/10"     # Tailscale CGNAT range
          - "127.0.0.1/32"      # Localhost

    # Authelia forward auth middleware
    authelia:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://10.100.2.202:9091/api/authz/forward-auth"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - "Remote-User"
          - "Remote-Groups"
          - "Remote-Email"
          - "Remote-Name"

    # Ollama API basic auth
    ollama-auth:
      basicAuth:
        users:
          - "ollama-api:$2y$05$DmLSIME.Uvr6TZEr.qSRK.Nwt9bzfSOV5RXPly9tD8hlQwSGhQz0i"
        realm: "Ollama API"

server:

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab running on Proxmox with LXC containers.

## Architecture

- **Hardware**: GMKTec evo-x1 (AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX370, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe)
- **Host OS**: Proxmox 9.0.3
- **Storage**: 5x 22TB HDD NAS via USB3.0 enclosure
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with per-app state files
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI integration

## Services

| App | Container ID | Description |
|-----|--------------|-------------|
| Traefik | 200 | Reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt |
| Dashboards | 201 | Homepage + Dashy |
| Immich | 304 | Photo management with ML |
| OpenWebUI | 501 | AI chat interface |
| Network Services | 101 | AdGuard Home DNS |
| Monitoring | 500 | Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting |

## Network Domains

- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public access via Cloudflare tunnel
- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal network
- `*.tailnet.rambtech.dev` - Tailscale VPN

```bash
# Setup state encryption (one-time)
task tofu:encryption:setup

# Initialize an app
task tofu:init APP=dashboards

# Plan and apply
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# SSH to deployed LXC
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards

# Sync compose changes
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards
```

```text
tofu/
├── apps/                # Per-app configs (each has own state)
│   ├── dashboards/      # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/          # Photo management (ID: 304)
```
